title: eval-harness: add CI hooks for prompt-set regression checks + metrics integration
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Add CI hooks to run prompt-set regression checks and upload eval metrics to observability. Enables gating on quality regressions and produces failure artifacts for debugging.
description:
Motivation: Several recent rollouts surfaced prompt-set regressions that weren't caught by unit tests. This PR adds CI hooks to the eval-harness pipeline to automatically run the canonical prompt-sets and surface per-prompt metrics (accuracy, BLEU, token-latency) as artifacts. The goal is to gate merges when regressions exceed thresholds and to provide consistent observability integrations for post-merge analysis.

What this PR does (summary): 1) Introduces a GitHub Actions job (eval-harness/regression-check) that spins up the eval harness container with pinned model snapshots and runs prompt-sets for changed models/routes; 2) Integrates metric reporters to upload JSON artifacts and push Prometheus-style metrics to our CI observability endpoint; 3) Adds a gating step that fails the job when delta against baseline crosses configured thresholds (configurable per-prompt); 4) Adds documentation and a small CLI helper to update baselines and re-run analyses.

Commits (high level): - 1a2b3c4: initial CI hook and workflow file; - 2b3c4d5: metric reporter + artifact uploader; - 3c4d5e6: gating logic and threshold config; - 4d5e6f7: docs + CLI helper; - 5e6f7g8: address review feedback and flaky test handling.

Changed files (high level): .github/workflows/eval-regression.yml, eval-harness/ci/hooks.py, eval-harness/metrics/reporter.py, eval-harness/config/prompt-baselines.yaml, eval-harness/cli/baseline_tool.py, docs/eval/ci-gating.md, tests/eval/test_regression_integration.py and a few small CI utils. No large model artifacts included.

Review conversation (high level): 
- Diego Marquez (2026-02-16): "Nice start; can we ensure timeouts for long-running prompt-sets and avoid blocking other CI jobs? Also request explicit rate limiting for observability uploads."
- Priya Nair (2026-02-16): "Added per-prompt timeouts and a bounded uploader with exponential backoff. See next commit."
- Aisha Khan (2026-02-18): "Gating thresholds look strict for few prompts (esp. summarization). Recommend adding opt-in overrides for release branches."
- Priya Nair (2026-02-18): "Added release-branch override whitelist and documented the override process in docs/eval/ci-gating.md."
- Samuel Lee (2026-02-20): "Found a flaky test that depends on network timing; suggested a retry and improved seeding."
- Priya Nair (2026-02-20): "Patched test harness to use deterministic RNG and added retry on transient metric uploads."
- Diego Marquez (2026-02-21): "Approved after CI green and doc updates."

CI checks and history: Initial run (2026-02-17) failed on one integration test (transient upload timeout). Reran after fixes; second run (2026-02-19) passed unit and integration tests but flagged two prompt regressions for a new model variant; thresholds were re-tuned and rerun. Final run (2026-02-22) passed all checks. Checks included: build, lint, unit-tests, eval-regression (this PR's new job), and publish-artifacts. Artifacts: eval-regression/results-745210.json, eval-regression/metrics-745210.prom.

Merge outcome: Squash merge into main after approvals and final CI green. No migrations required.

Rollout/Operational notes: The gating thresholds are conservative and stored in eval-harness/config/prompt-baselines.yaml. Platform teams will get a heads-up via the #platform-evals Slack channel on rollout. We recommend monitoring the eval job for the next two weeks to detect noisy prompts; a dashboard is available at Observability > CI/Eval (linked in docs).
commits: 1a2b3c4: add eval-regression workflow and basic runner
2b3c4d5: implement metrics reporter and artifact upload
notes: This change enables automated prompt-set regression gating in CI and uploads artifacts for debugging. Teams can opt-out per release branch using the whitelist. Expect minor CI time increase (~3-4 minutes) when eval-regression runs.
